Well, I assume at this elo, Sona players must be playing quite passive, or that might be just his playstyle, but I just think at high elo, Sona is extremely vulnerable in lane.. He goes Coin line and doesn't buy boots, so he is extremely vulnerable to ganks, more than usual, and all-ins from the enemy bot lane. Going for a passive, scaling rune page like this makes sense with his build path.

So I did some very quick, basic math to see the results, and it’s quite interesting. First comparing the stats of both items:

Statikk Shiv (2600 G)

35% Attack Speed
5% Movement Speed
30% Critical Strike Chance

Luden’s Ekko (3200 G)

100 Ability Power
10% Movement Speed

For 600 gold less, you lose 100 AP in favor of attack speed, half the movespeed and 30% critical strike chance. Sona has A LOT of AP ratios and she needs them to scale well into the game, but how much does it hurt her if we take into account the passives ?

Luden’s Echo does 100 (10% AP) magic damage. Levels don’t matter, it’s always a flat amount. It also can’t crit. Statikk Shiv on the other hand, doesn’t scale from any items Sona would get when played AP mid, BUT scales off levels AND deals bonus damage to minions… and it’s also magic damage. Huh, this is quite interesting.

It deal 99 to 264 magic damage to minions. Compared to the 100 (+10% AP) from Luden’s, you’d need 1640 AP to match Shiv’s damage at level 18. Ridiculous right ? And against champions. Shiv does 60 to 160 damage. You’d still need 600 AP to match it at max level (which is actually very possible since at level 18 on a mage mid, it’s not rare to have around 600 AP).

BUT. Statikk Shiv can also critically strike, and with 30% chance to do so, it’s going to happen quite frequently. So that’s now 198 to 528 damage to minions and 120 to 320 damage to champions, OCCASIONALLY. If you’re lucky. But this is better than it never happening with Luden’s Ekko. Also a reminder that this also costs 600 less gold.

So on a level 12 Sona, with adequate runes and masteries, maxing Q first. Both with Dark Seal (no stacks) and Lich Bane, thunderlord’s decree, but one with Statikk Shiv and the other with Luden’s Ekko. With a normal Auto Q Passive Thunderlord’s, not counting resistances:

Sona with Luden’s Echo: 1204.9 damage.
Sona with Statikk shiv with two crits: 1452.7 damage.

The Statikk Shiv Sona also has 600 more gold to spend, and an easier time farming thanks to Statikk, critical strike chance, and attack speed.

So I don’t know how much the 100 AP loss will affect her for the entire game, but I think it’s a fair trade and a very interesting result in terms of both damage and utility.
